# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]
[Vectron X Primary - Tec Keyvisual 16to9]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

boosting income for the local community by 60%.

## Write an investor-ready business plan from scratch

Most founder business plans never see an investor because they were written for the wrong audience
using the wrong template. The Business Plan Playbook Ebook is the founder-friendly guide to writing
a serious plan that actually gets read - covering structure, financial section depth, market sizing
and the narrative arc investors and lenders look for.

By the end you will have a business plan structure that works for both fundraising and operating,
plus the templates to fill it in.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and
  everything in between.
* Prompt Pack Get inspired with prompts that help you articulate your business goals, mission,
  vision, and strategies clearly and persuasively. Perfect for crafting investor-ready plans or
  improving internal alignment.
* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and
  templates to guide you through writing each section of your business plan.
* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.
  Follow this roadmap to ensure no detail is overlooked.
* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable
  Word-Document for your convenience.
* Financial Plan Template Create a solid financial foundation for your business with a detailed
  financial plan template. Includes revenue projections, expense tracking, cash flow analysis, and
  break-even calculations, all tailored for startups and small businesses. This template is
  available in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) to suit your needs.
* Aspiring entrepreneurs looking to bring their ideas to life.

high-purity distribution. We specialize in providing the high-performance ingredients that drive

technically superior ingredients.

# Global Supply Chain Leader
# in High-Purity Chemical Wholesale

CanCastor is a premier global partner for industrial chemical sourcing, technical validation, and
high-purity distribution. We specialize in providing the high-performance ingredients that drive
modern manufacturing.

### Global Sourcing & Distribution

Our universal chemical supply chain delivers a comprehensive portfolio of Glycerol Esters,
Surfactants, Sorbitan derivatives, and specialized industrial additives. We leverage a strategic
logistics network across North America and Europe to ensure secure, on-time bulk delivery of
technically superior ingredients.

### Technical Excellence & Quality Assurance

Every product in our catalog is backed by a technical 'Documentation Vault'. We provide full MSDS,
TDS, and lot-specific Certificates of Analysis (COA) for all bulk shipments, ensuring total
compliance for your quality control teams.

### Strategic Wholesale Solutions

We provide competitive wholesale pricing models and flexible supply contracts tailored to the needs
of pharmaceutical, food, and industrial manufacturers. Partner with a global leader dedicated to
technical transparency and supply chain reliability.

# Strategic consulting for renewable energy and cleantech growth

EAI helps businesses and investors accelerate their clean energy journey with research-driven
strategy, market entry, due diligence, and implementation support across Solar, Wind, Bio-energy and
more.

[Talk to an expert][12] [View services][13]

### Why teams choose EAI
* ✅ Two decades in India’s RE ecosystem
* ✅ End-to-end support from strategy to execution
* ✅ Global clients across Fortune 500, SMEs and investors

### Who are we?

Energy Alternatives India (EAI) is a boutique research and consulting firm focused on the renewable
energy & cleantech sectors. [Founded by IIT & IIM alumni][14], we combine deep domain knowledge,
marketing expertise, and a wide industry network — making us one of India's most sought-after
advisory firms. [More »][15]

### Where do we operate?

We operate across the entire renewable energy & cleantech spectrum, with special focus on:
* [Solar PV][16]
* [Biomass][17]

Other sectors
* [Wind O&M][18]
* [Solar Thermal][19]
* [BioPlastics & Biopolymers][20]
* [Emerging Cleantech][21]

### Who can we help?

EAI's consulting practice assists manufacturers diversifying into solar, solar companies expanding
within their sector, and international firms entering the Indian market. We also help enterprises
and entrepreneurs with strategy, commercial planning, finance and project implementation for
[renewable power plants][22] and sustainable energy blueprints.

### What are our focus areas?

We provide a wide range of services for stakeholders across the renewable energy value chain:
* **Diversification into / within Renewable Energy**We assist businesses diversify into renewable
  energy or expand within the sector. [Read more][23]
* **Market Entry for International Firms**Specialized support to international firms entering India
  — from market strategy to implementation. [Read more][24]
* **Solar Due Diligence for M&A**Market & technical due diligence across solar PV and solar thermal
  value chains. [Read more][25]
* **Assisting Industrial Consumers Go Green**Industrial energy consumers get tailored solutions for
  Solar PV, Solar Thermal, Wind and Bio-Energy integration. [Read more][26]
* **Research & Publications**Whitepapers and reports used by decision-makers worldwide — from
  mainstream topics to specialized niche research. [Read more][27]
* **Renewable Energy Catalysis**We organise major conferences, exhibitions, and networking events
  and maintain a broad digital presence including a widely-read newsletter. [Read more][28]

### Who are our clients?

Our clients include large corporates, foundations and global organisations — Reliance Industries,
Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, General Electric, Accenture, ExxonMobil, World Bank, Bosch and
others. [Read more][29]

advisory firms. [More »][15]

are the link between chemical industry and commercial end users with over 50 years of experience and
some of the most prestigious companies in its client list.

Our products are distributed under the brand name of our principle products and it is well
recognized with quality in the market for over decades.

CPC is one of the reliable company for supply chain of chemicals for the Indian chemicals industry.

# Welcome

# Decisions Advisors

Empowering global businesses through deep market intelligence.

### Who We Are?

**Decisions Advisors** is a comprehensive market research and consulting company that provides
actionable insights based on data. We deal with businesses from various industries and deliver a
market intelligence, competitive analysis, forecasting, and bespoke consulting. We also conduct
bespoke consulting for our clients.

The team at Decisions Advisors is proficient in a given industry and uses the latest research
techniques in the industry to provide guidance on informed decision making and also help in finding
expansion opportunities.The company provides well-supported advice and intelligence on how
businesses can operate in a given market and succeed in achieving their goals.

[About us ][25]

#### [Data-Driven Insights][26]

At Decisions Advisors, we strive to provide keen insights that motivate tangible action. Our mission
is to provide dependable solutions based on comprehensive analysis tailored to our clients’ evolving
demands. We integrate industry knowledge with a pragmatic approach to create research strategies
that address particular business challenges.

#### [Customized Research Solutions][27]

We develop customized research approaches based on your business objectives, providing actionable
insights that yield quantifiable outcomes, assist in strategic decision-making, and generate
sustainable value across shifting market environments.

#### [Industry Expertise][28]

With actionable insights across diverse sectors, our experts blend in-depth knowledge and sharp
analysis to decode intricate markets and grasp their underlying structures.

#### [Global Reach, Local Focus][29]

Provide insights that balance global perspective with local relevance, ensuring our research
captures both worldwide trends and the specific dynamics of regional markets for smarter decisions.

ひまし油のトップブランド

伊藤製油は明治5年創業以来、「ひまし油の可能性を求めて
ひとすじに」を合言葉に、ひまし油の高品質化を実現し、トップブランドとして地球環境にやさしい天然の恵み
であるひまし油とその誘導体を安定供給しています。当社の製品は、人への安全性が⾼く、環境負荷が少ないた
めに、家庭用品をはじめとして、医療、船舶、⾞両、建材、⼟⽊など多彩な分野において化成品としてご使用い
ただいております。ひまし油の応用研究を推進し、石油の代替などの可能性を探求して地球環境に貢献していま
す。

地球環境に貢献する
ひまし油のトップブランド

伊藤製油は明治5年創業以来、「ひまし油の可能性を求めて
ひとすじに」を合言葉に、ひまし油の高品質化を実現し、トップブランドとして地球環境にやさしい天然の恵み
であるひまし油とその誘導体を安定供給しています。当社の製品は、人への安全性が⾼く、環境負荷が少ないた
めに、家庭用品をはじめとして、医療、船舶、⾞両、建材、⼟⽊など多彩な分野において化成品としてご使用い
ただいております。ひまし油の応用研究を推進し、石油の代替などの可能性を探求して地球環境に貢献していま
す。

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

[LEARN MORE][20]

# P&G Chemicals develops bio-based materials that can be used in a wide range of applications.
* Our products are created from responsibly sourced natural feedstocks. [Learn more here][9].
* Our portfolio of fatty alcohols, fatty acids, methyl esters and glycerin offers you a choice of
  low carbon options, including carbon negative and near carbon neutral versions. [Learn more
  here][10].
* Suitable for use in a wide range of applications including: agrochemicals, pharmaceuticals,
  personal care, fabric & home care products and lubricants.

## New carbon footprint solutions

**P&G Chemicals offer a range of carbon footprint solutions to help meet your business needs and
those of your customers.**

Through a combination of sourcing and manufacturing expertise we are able to provide a range of
options.
Our Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) are calculated from cradle to gate and include biogenic uptake.

Regular

Our mainline offering provides a **lower carbon** footprint than industry average carbon footprint*.

[Learn More][11]

Low

Our premium offering has a **significantly lower carbon** footprint than industry average*, helping
you make progress on your decarbonization journey.

[Learn More][12]

Ultra Low

Our flagship offering is **carbon negative**, an ideal choice to help you develop carbon neutral
formulations.

[Learn More][13]

* based on ERASM 2017 SLE Project PKO data + PGC scope 1, 2 and 3. To learn more, please contact us
[here][14].

The methodology used to calculate the Carbon Footprint through our supply chain is based on the ISO
14067 standard and follows the **Together for Sustainability** guideline. It has been certified in
2024 by **TUV Rheinland**, an independent organization of experts. The Product Carbon Footprints
(PCF) offered under our 3 different solutions have been verified in 2024 by TÜV Rheinland.

## Our product range

## Fatty Alcohols

We offer mid and heavy cut fatty alcohols. Our manufacturing operations in Europe, Asia, and
Americas provide responsiveness and supply assurance across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][15]

## Fatty Acids

We offer a range of high purity short chain fatty acids, suitable for a wide range of applications
including MCTs (Medium-Chain Triglycerides), lubricants and agricultural chemical formulations.

[LEARN MORE][16]

## Glycerin

For over 160 years, we have produced high quality glycerin. Today our range includes USP and FCC
grade with GMP Certificate for Food (BRC, FSSC).

[LEARN MORE][17]

## Methyl Esters

Our portfolio of methyl esters includes a variety of broad and high purity cuts that can be supplied
across the globe.

[LEARN MORE][18]

## Get to know us

P&G Chemicals has been making products using naturally derived chemistry for over 160 years. We were
first established to deliver the high-quality ingredients and supply chains that Procter & Gamble
(our parent company) needed to develop our superior branded consumer products. Today our horizons
have broadened – so we serve not only P&G but leading chemical companies, in over 40 countries
across the globe, as a trusted supplier of naturally derived bio-solutions. 

[LEARN MORE][19]

## Sustainability

Our passion is to act as a catalyst for sustainable business growth – through responsibly sourced,
natural based low carbon products. With a global technical, manufacturing and supply chain network
based in North America, Europe and Asia, we think globally and act locally delivering quality,
reliablity and supply chain resilience.

Our products are designed with our impact, your impact and your customers needs in mind. We do this
by responsibly sourcing natural materials, creating products that enable our customers to reduce
their footprint and by driving positive impacts through partnerships and programs.

Raw and Blanched Peanuts, Raisins, Mung Beans, and Spices.

# RD Commodities - Navigating the Global Agri Commodities Market Through Strategic Solutions

R.D.Commodities, based in the vibrant city of Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, is your trusted partner in
the global trade of agricultural commodities. We are dedicated to serving your needs with the utmost
diligence.


Located in the Gujarat state of India, R.D.Commodities Private Limited is a professional trading and
indenting firm of Agricultural Commodities, mainly dealing in Castor Oil Derivatives, Castor Seeds,
Fertilizers, Feedstuff, Grains, and Edible Oils.


Moreover, we have also played an essential role in the global procurement and referencing of other
agricultural products such as Seeds, Beans, Raisins, and Spices.


As one of the most prominent agri commodity trading and indenting firms, we strive to provide a
transparent service of importing and exporting agri-commodity products. In our journey, we have
transformed many of our fellow buyers’ aspirations into reality by offering them affordability,
sustainability, and excellence — in products as well as services.

## Our Products - Where Quality Meets Excellence

Our diverse portfolio encompasses a range of top-tier commodities, including Castor Oil and
Derivatives, Fertilizers, Feedstuff, Grains, Peanut Oil, Edible Oil, Industrial Oil, Castor Seeds,
Raw and Blanched Peanuts, Raisins, Mung Beans, and Spices.

 

With a dedicated focus on quality and precision, we ensure that each product within our offering
meets your requirements with the highest industry standards.

The Solvent Extractors’ Association of India was formed in 1963 to help and foster the development
and growth of Solvent Extraction Industry in India. At present the Association is having 875 members
including about 350 working solvent extraction plants having combined oilcake/oilseed processing
annual capacity of about 30 million tonnes.

The Association is an all India body to solvent extractions industry and premier vegetable oil
Association in the country having wide representative membership consisting of processors of Rice
bran, Oilcakes, Minor Oilseeds and Soybean.

researched, honestly priced, and written for people who want to understand why a formula works.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

## The 4,000-Year-Old Compound Science Is Finally Catching Up To

Castor oil has been used in medicine for over 4,000 years. Ancient Egyptians used it. Cleopatra
relied on it. Traditional healers across cultures called it “Palma Christi” — the Palm of Christ —
because of its remarkable healing properties.

Modern science now explains why.

Castor oil is 90% ricinoleic acid — a fatty acid found almost nowhere else in nature. Ricinoleic
acid is one of the only natural compounds ever shown to break down biofilm, the protective shield
that parasites, bacteria, and other organisms build around themselves to avoid detection and
elimination.

But here’s what matters: you can’t just drink it. When you swallow castor oil, your stomach acid
degrades the ricinoleic acid before it reaches your intestines. What survives gets diluted across
your entire digestive tract. The concentration never gets high enough to do anything meaningful.

That’s why delivery method is everything.

When castor oil is applied to the skin over the abdomen with sustained compression and body heat,
the ricinoleic acid absorbs transdermally — bypassing digestion entirely. It reaches the tissue
surrounding your intestines at full concentration, directly where parasites burrow and build their
biofilm armor.
